Kuwait Electricity and Water Bill Calculator

Pick the property type and enter your monthly electricity and water use to see your bill at the Ministry of Electricity and Water's applied tariff.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Work out your bill

In gallons as on the bill, or choose cubic metres.

Kuwait's applied electricity and water tariffs

SectorElectricity (fils/kWh)Water (KD per 1,000 gallons)
Private housing20.800
Investment housing52.000
Commercial52.000
Industrial and agricultural31.250
Chalets, stables and others122.000
Government254.000

Law 20 of 2016 set tariff ceilings; the new prices applied to commercial property from 22 May 2017 and to investment housing from 22 August 2017, while private housing kept its old tariff. One cubic metre is 219.969 imperial gallons, so investment-housing water costs about 440 fils per m³.

Worked examples

An expat flat in investment housing using 1,500 kWh and 20 m³ (4,399 gallons): electricity 1,500 × 0.005 = KD 7.500, water 4,399.4 × 2 ÷ 1,000 = KD 8.799, a total of KD 16.299. If the tenant is a registered Kuwaiti on the private-housing tariff: 3.000 + 3.520 = KD 6.520.

A citizen's villa in private housing using 5,000 kWh and 60 m³ (13,198 gallons): electricity KD 10 and water KD 10.559, a total of KD 20.559.

Many buildings have no water meter per flat, so the landlord pays water and builds it into the rent. The ministry says a kWh costs it about 48 fils, so a private-housing resident pays 2 fils and the state covers 46.

Frequently asked questions

What is the electricity price per kWh in Kuwait in 2026?

2 fils in private housing (citizens' homes), 5 fils in investment housing and commercial property, 3 fils for industry and agriculture, 12 fils for chalets and stables and 25 fils for government, with no slabs.

What is the water tariff in Kuwait?

800 fils per 1,000 imperial gallons in private housing, KD 2 in investment and commercial property, KD 1.250 for industry and agriculture and KD 4 for government.

Does a Kuwaiti in an investment flat pay the expat rate?

No. They pay the private-housing rate for one unit if they have no other housing support and submit the documents, under Law 20 of 2016 and Ministerial Resolution 2 of 2017.

Did Kuwait raise electricity tariffs in 2025 or 2026?

A January 2025 Amiri decree allows public-service charges to be repriced with Cabinet approval, but we found no implemented increase in electricity or water tariffs up to November 2026.
